name: 碧血残阳 之「豪侠晚歌」
english_name: Jade Blood, Fading Sun: Ballad of the Twilight Knight
english_description: Part of the "Sunset Reborn" engine family shared with several sibling archives in this project, built, per the author, atop "Sunset Reborn – Jianghu Storm 2 – Storm Resurgent." New characters are placed at random into one of several starting towns across a jianghu spanning Jiaxing, Yangzhou, and other locales, with gender-specific scene descriptions and a full underworld resurrection subsystem shared with sibling games in the same engine family.
